description: The OpenUGD package family as the tools see it. 'root' holds one checkout (or worktree) per repo; OPENUGD_ROOT or --root overrides it. 'packages' is the default set for level1/level2, in dependency order. finish.sh fast-forwards 'target' to 'source' in the main checkout that owns each worktree.

release.description: release-check.sh: the version the train is tagged as (each tag equals package.json 'version', no prefix, as the existing tags are) and the 'unity' minimum every package declares (DECISIONS-v2: minimum Unity 6000.0).

held.reason: Merge only after com.openugd.context 2.0.0 is live on OpenUPM, so the banner never links to a 404 (DECISIONS-v2, decision 3). finish.sh never touches it.

outsideTrain.note: com.openugd.configuration 0.x: checked by level 1 when listed with --packages; not part of the 2.0 release and has no main checkout yet.
